proposed.text: Phil Coulson recruits Fitz and Jemma Simmons to his team, and the young engineer becomes one of his most loyal agents and friends. Fitz builds much of the gear Coulson relies on, like the Night-Night Pistol.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22
split.text: Fury makes Coulson the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D., and Fitz stays at his side.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Fitz's director and friend, for whom he builds gear.
split.on_b_card_about_a: One of Coulson's most loyal agents and friends, who stays at his side.

verdicts.why: Coulson only becomes Director in S1#22, so the split is right, but 'Night-Night pistol' is said on screen in S1#4 for the pistol version, so the current name stays.
S1#17: May tells Coulson she, not he, made the team, reporting on the candidates for Fury.
Fury and Deathlok first meet at Cybertek in S1#22, where Fury joins Coulson and Peterson strikes Garrett.

proposed.text: Anne Weaver and Bobbi Morse sit together on Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. council, which sends Bobbi undercover into Coulson's team. When Lance Hunter escapes, Weaver works out how long he needs to reach land, and Bobbi says she can get Fury's toolbox sooner.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow council member who plans the move on Coulson's base with Bobbi.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#17
split.text: Aboard the Iliad, Weaver and Bobbi keep Fitz under watch after he leaves and press Melinda May about Coulson's secret Theta Protocol.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow council member, pressing May with Weaver about Theta.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow council member, pressing May with Bobbi about Theta.

verdicts.why: S2#14 has Weaver's 12 hours and Bobbi's promise to get the toolbox in six, but Weaver is not in S2#16 and the Theta Protocol questioning of May with Bobbi is in S2#17 (Melinda).
S2#5 is the cloaked Quinjet rooftop pickup by Trip; the Boston hunt for Ward with Bobbi, Hunter and May is S2#7.
S2#20 is only the kidnapping; the needle torture is S2#21 and Bobbi taking the bullet from Ward's trap is S2#22.
Kara helps kidnap Bobbi in S2#20; the torture and Bobbi standing by her choice are S2#21.
S2#15: May catches Bobbi stealing the toolbox and they fight before an EMP lets her escape; no window flip or letting agents in.
S2#5 end tag: Cal offers Whitehall an alliance against their common enemy Coulson; he first attacks Coulson in S2#10, where the name Daisy is also first given.
S2#8 shows Cal finding his dissected wife's remains; Jiaying is first shown as his wife in S2#16 and he kills her in S2#22.
In S2#10 Cal only says Whitehall killed her mother; that Jiaying is her mother is the S2#17 reveal.

proposed.text: Jiaying, the leader of the Inhuman haven Afterlife, stops Skye from attacking Raina and offers to be her guide.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Leader of Afterlife, who offers to be Daisy's guide.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A new Inhuman Jiaying offers to guide at Afterlife.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#17
split.text: During training, Jiaying reveals that she is Skye's mother and asks her to keep it secret.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Jiaying's daughter, whom she trains at Afterlife.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#22
split.text: When Skye stops her plan aboard the Iliad, Jiaying tries to drain her life force, until Cal kills her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's mother. Tries to drain Daisy's life force.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Jiaying's daughter. Jiaying tries to drain her life force.

verdicts.why: The S2#16/#17/#22 split is right, but 'without saying who she is' hints at the S2#17 reveal, so it is dropped.
S3#11: Werner has been in S.H.I.E.L.D. custody in a vegetative state; Coulson uses the memory machine on him and he says 'Just kill me'.
S3#11: the team catches Elena, she helps rescue Bobbi and Hunter, and she agrees to join the Secret Warriors, staying in Colombia on call.
S3#18: Daisy smashes the Terrigen crystal in James's home while Hive watches.
Slingshot#5: Daisy came for the weapon, frees Yo-Yo and blasts Ramon aside; Ramon dies in #6.
The detailed S3#16 account: Whitehall urges the brothers to follow his path, Gideon calls him a coward and refuses, and Whitehall hints at their father's trick.
S2#22: Coulson, Mack and Fitz stop Gordon in the vent room and Coulson loses his hand catching a crystal; Skye downs Jiaying's Quinjet.
Whitehall brainwashes Agent 33 (S2#3); that Bakshi's team kidnapped her is only revealed in S2#14.
S2#9: Hunter helps guard Raina in Vancouver and he and May drive the SUV into Hydra when she tries to surrender; her visions come later.
S2#15 flashback: Mack talks Bobbi out of destroying the Iliad against Gonzales's reminder of Fury's order, and they retake the ship.
S2#11: Coulson and May are 'shot' in a staged ambush so Bakshi escapes and leads them to Hydra's leaders; Hunter then returns him to custody.
S4#4 Coulson meets Aida as Radcliffe's assistant and takes her for an amputee; she knocks him out in S4#9 and he burns her as Ghost Rider in S4#22.
S4#7: Robbie returns through Aida's portal; the Ghost Rider first wounds her with his chain in S4#22.
Davis pilots Zephyr One to the Principia in S5#13; the Chicago Quinjet flight and rushing the fainting Coulson back is S5#22.
S3#17: Lincoln captures Malick in the oil field raid; Hive has been on Earth since S3#10.
S3#8 ends with Malick taking Ward in, and in S3#9 Ward calls on Giyera to torture Simmons until Fitz agrees to help.
Piper serves on May's S4 STRIKE team, but in S5#11 she hands the team to Hale, so 'stays a loyal friend' is a later and wrong claim.
Hale recruits Creel to her team in S5#11; her Hydra tie comes in S5#13-14, and S5#16 has the old-Hydra talk, the Gravitonium and Creel freeing Coulson and Talbot.
Izel kills Davis in S6#10, and Piper flies with the team to the temple and asks Sarge to end Izel in S6#12.
S5#10 ends with Deke seemingly dead; S5#11 reveals he survived and came back with the team.
Talbot absorbs the gravitonium in S5#19, but Deke's 'not so bad' reaction is in the S5#20 aftermath (Deke page cites AoS520), so the S5#20 stage is right as it stands.
Hale's Hydra allegiance is first shown in S5#13-14, after S5#11.
By S5#18 Hale is known as Hydra, so the fact belongs on the later card.
S5#11 ends revealing the assassin is Hale's daughter Ruby; her Hydra tie comes later.
Fitz agrees to help perfect Aida in S4#1, uncovers Radcliffe's betrayal and LMD in S4#11, and is the Doctor in the Framework in S4#16.
Mack and Yo-Yo reconcile and rekindle their relationship in S6#9 (Collision Course Part 2).

proposed.text: On Kang's orders, Darren Cross, now M.O.D.O.K., uses Cassie's signal to pull Janet and her family into the Quantum Realm. He later brings down the ship carrying her husband Hank and leaves him to die.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hank's wife, whom Cross pulls into the Quantum Realm for Kang.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Kang's enforcer, who pulls Janet's family into the Quantum Realm.

verdicts.why: M.O.D.O.K. never hunts Janet, but he does use Cassie's signal to pull her and her family into the Quantum Realm and later downs her ship with Hank aboard, which is between the two, unlike a hunt for Scott and Cassie.
Hope and Scott throw Kang into the power core at the end; Janet trapped him earlier.
The marriage is only from an actor interview; on screen they are both Thanos's children who ambush Wanda and Vision in Edinburgh, and Proxima takes the wounded Corvus back to their ship.
Killmonger comes close to killing Shuri in the final battle before T'Challa saves her, not when he takes the throne.
Toussaint is first revealed in the Wakanda Forever mid-credits scene.
Nakia frees Shuri and Williams from Talokan, killing two Talokanil guards.
Peggy drugging Zola is from the tie-in comic (CAFV3); in the film Zola is captured on the train and his intel finds the last Hydra base.
The Ayo and Natasha standoff happens as T'Challa leaves the Joint Counter Terrorist Centre in Berlin after Bucky escapes.
Sharon first appears in FWS#3, where Sam promises a pardon; the pardon and the Power Broker reveal are in #6.
Owner ruling question 37 keeps 'Crossbones' though it is never said in Civil War, and that name is the only point of this fix.

Coulson learns he was revived on Fury's orders in S1#11, and Fury names him Director in S1#22.
